mapper.select: SELECT bracket_id, lower_bound, upper_bound, tax_rate, progressive_deduction FROM gift_tax_bracket WHERE effective_from <= #{asOfDate} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{asOfDate}) ORDER BY lower_bound

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_type, 'DEPOSIT' AS product_category, MIN(r.interest_rate) AS min_annual_rate_percent, MAX(r.interest_rate) AS max_annual_rate_percent, MIN(r.interest_rate) AS applied_annual_rate_percent, MIN(r.min_month) AS min_month, MAX(r.max_month) AS max_month, d.min_amount, d.max_amount, MAX(r.base_date) AS product_data_date FROM kb_product p JOIN deposit d ON d.product_id = p.product_id JOIN interest_rate r ON r.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND (r.min_month IS NULL OR r.min_month <= #{investmentPeriodMonths}) AND (r.max_month IS NULL OR r.max_month >= #{investmentPeriodMonths}) GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_type, d.min_amount, d.max_amount ORDER BY applied_annual_rate_percent DESC, p.product_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_type, s.product_category, MIN(r.interest_rate) AS min_annual_rate_percent, MAX(r.interest_rate) AS max_annual_rate_percent, MIN(r.interest_rate) AS applied_annual_rate_percent, MIN(r.min_month) AS min_month, MAX(r.max_month) AS max_month, s.monthly_min_amount, s.monthly_max_amount, MAX(r.base_date) AS product_data_date FROM kb_product p JOIN savings s ON s.product_id = p.product_id JOIN interest_rate r ON r.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_type = 'SAVINGS' AND (r.min_month IS NULL OR r.min_month <= #{investmentPeriodMonths}) AND (r.max_month IS NULL OR r.max_month >= #{investmentPeriodMonths}) GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_type, s.product_category, s.monthly_min_amount, s.monthly_max_amount ORDER BY applied_annual_rate_percent DESC, p.product_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_type, e.etf_category AS product_category, e.annual_return_5y AS min_annual_rate_percent, e.annual_return_5y AS max_annual_rate_percent, e.annual_return_5y AS applied_annual_rate_percent, e.benchmark_name AS tracking_index, e.risk_level, e.product_detail_url, DATE(e.updated_at) AS product_data_date FROM kb_product p JOIN etf e ON e.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_type = 'ETF' AND e.etf_category IN ('DOMESTIC_INDEX', 'FOREIGN_INDEX', 'BOND_MIXED') AND e.annual_return_5y IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.annual_return_5y DESC, p.product_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO simulation ( family_id, requested_amount, status, tax_payment_method, investment_period_months, as_of_date, investment_end_date, recommended_scenario_type, previous_gift_amount, remaining_deduction_amount, deduction_reset_date, calculation_version, formula_version, product_data_date, version, created_at, expired_at ) VALUES ( #{familyId}, #{requestedAmount}, #{status}, #{taxPaymentMethod}, #{investmentPeriodMonths}, #{asOfDate}, #{investmentEndDate}, #{recommendedScenarioType}, #{previousGiftAmount}, #{remainingDeductionAmount}, #{deductionResetDate}, #{calculationVersion}, #{formulaVersion}, #{productDataDate}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{expiredAt} )

INSERT INTO simulation_result ( simulation_id, scenario_type, risk_profile, deduction_amount, taxable_amount, gift_tax, donor_required_amount, post_tax_amount, current_amount, deferred_amount, investment_principal, expected_future_value, created_at ) VALUES ( #{simulationId}, #{scenarioType}, #{riskProfile}, #{deductionAmount}, #{taxableAmount}, #{giftTax}, #{donorRequiredAmount}, #{postTaxAmount}, #{currentAmount}, #{deferredAmount}, #{investmentPrincipal}, #{expectedFutureValue}, #{createdAt} )

INSERT INTO simulation_tranche ( result_id, sequence_no, gift_date, gift_amount, estimated_gift_tax, donor_required_amount, investment_amount ) VALUES ( #{resultId}, #{sequenceNo}, #{giftDate}, #{giftAmount}, #{estimatedGiftTax}, #{donorRequiredAmount}, #{investmentAmount} )

INSERT INTO simulation_product ( result_id, product_id, product_name_snapshot, recommendation_type, product_category_snapshot, is_selected, default_allocated_amount, default_allocation_ratio, min_annual_rate_percent, max_annual_rate_percent, applied_annual_rate_percent, calculation_type, default_expected_future_value, default_expected_profit, min_month, max_month, min_amount, max_amount, monthly_min_amount, monthly_max_amount, preferential_conditions_snapshot, tracking_index_snapshot, market_capitalization_snapshot, dividend_yield_percent_snapshot, risk_level_snapshot, product_detail_url_snapshot, product_data_date, created_at ) VALUES ( #{resultId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{productType}, #{productCategory}, #{selected}, #{allocatedAmount}, #{allocationRatio}, #{minAnnualRatePercent}, #{maxAnnualRatePercent}, #{appliedAnnualRatePercent}, #{calculationType}, #{expectedFutureValue}, #{expectedProfit}, #{minMonth}, #{maxMonth}, #{minAmount}, #{maxAmount}, #{monthlyMinAmount}, #{monthlyMaxAmount}, #{preferentialConditions}, #{trackingIndex}, #{marketCapitalization}, #{dividendYieldPercent}, #{riskLevel}, #{productDetailUrl}, #{productDataDate}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, f.user_id, f.family_name, f.relation, f.birth_date FROM simulation s JOIN family f ON f.family_id = s.family_id WHERE s.simulation_id = #{simulationId}
SELECT * FROM simulation_result WHERE simulation_id = #{simulationId} ORDER BY result_id
SELECT t.* FROM simulation_tranche t JOIN simulation_result r ON r.result_id = t.result_id WHERE r.simulation_id = #{simulationId} ORDER BY t.result_id, t.sequence_no

SELECT simulation_product_id, result_id, product_id, product_name_snapshot AS product_name, recommendation_type AS product_type, product_category_snapshot AS product_category, is_selected AS selected, default_allocated_amount, default_allocation_ratio, default_expected_future_value, default_expected_profit, allocated_amount, allocation_ratio, min_annual_rate_percent, max_annual_rate_percent, applied_annual_rate_percent, calculation_type, expected_future_value, expected_profit, min_month, max_month, min_amount, max_amount, monthly_min_amount, monthly_max_amount, preferential_conditions_snapshot AS preferential_conditions, tracking_index_snapshot AS tracking_index, market_capitalization_snapshot AS market_capitalization, dividend_yield_percent_snapshot AS dividend_yield_percent, risk_level_snapshot AS risk_level, product_detail_url_snapshot AS product_detail_url, product_data_date FROM simulation_product WHERE result_id IN ( SELECT result_id FROM simulation_result WHERE simulation_id = #{simulationId} ) ORDER BY result_id, recommendation_type, simulation_product_id
mapper.update: UPDATE simulation_product SET is_selected = 0, allocated_amount = NULL, allocation_ratio = NULL, expected_future_value = NULL, expected_profit = NULL WHERE result_id = #{resultId}

UPDATE simulation_product SET is_selected = 1, allocated_amount = #{allocatedAmount}, allocation_ratio = #{allocationRatio}, applied_annual_rate_percent = #{appliedAnnualRatePercent}, expected_future_value = #{expectedFutureValue}, expected_profit = #{expectedProfit} WHERE simulation_product_id = #{simulationProductId}

UPDATE simulation SET status = 'SAVED', selected_scenario_type = #{selectedScenarioType}, selected_result_id = #{selectedResultId}, selected_risk_profile = #{selectedRiskProfile}, saved_at = #{savedAt}, expired_at = #{expiredAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE simulation_id = #{simulationId} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
